Lewis Hamilton won 84 Grands Prix driving for Mercedes between 2000 and 2025.

The wins list returned 105 races in total. Twenty-one of those were with McLaren (2007–2012). Counting the 84 entries tagged "Mercedes" directly by season gives the same figure: 1 (2013), 11 (2014), 10 (2015), 10 (2016), 9 (2017), 11 (2018), 11 (2019), 11 (2020), 8 (2021) and 2 (2024).

ANSWER: 84
